decision: ACCEPT exact-label-comparison-v3 as a separately scoped offline metric and rebaseline only; ratewords runtime remains REJECTED
limitations: No official MathQA score claim; metric change starts a separate series.
Bare labels compare numeric coefficient only and do not check requested units or prediction dimensions.
Explicit units compare exact labels, not whether the dataset answer is mathematically or linguistically correct.
All unsupported rows retained; answered unsupported gold is unscorable, also report conservative wrong aggregation.
Old sparse reports preserve no individual refusal payloads; hashes/counts/index coverage imply refusals.
Rejected runtime candidate receives no acceptance or gain point.
